beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part three. The treatment beats: color interpolation sweeping through terracotta path by path, a kinetic grid tiling the mark across the frame on staggered delays, glitch slices that offset and snap clean, and a trail echo with five ghost copies chasing the slide.

Your turn. Paste this: sweep my logo through terracotta and back, path by path, left to right — and tell me whether the sweep reads as brand moment or as loading indicator. If it reads as loading, the duration is wrong.
Bear Brown logo, in motion. Part three. Liam, in for Bear.
